content_zh:
FS001魔武世界
魔武世界，是当代科技的最高结晶。融合了虚拟现实技术与网络游戏技术，而开发出的人类第二世界！
张允本是一个普通的人，但是在魔武世界中，他却是一个巅峰级强者。
魔武世界中，一头神话级远古炎龙熄灭了亘古不灭的火焰，倒在了张允的身前。张允熟练的抽筋扒皮放血，然后才收起了炎龙爆出的物品。
龙族生性贪婪，神话级远古炎龙的洞穴内，各种各样的魔法金属、魔法宝石成堆成山！作为胜利者，张允毫不客气的将所有原材料统统收走。
都瑞斯主城内，鉴定所中，张允怀着激动的心情走到鉴定师面前，客气道：“我要鉴定装备！”
周围的人看着他走到最高等级的鉴定师面前时，已经好奇的围观起来。
虽然张允在游戏中是巅峰级强者，可是他一直比较低调，因此认识他的人并不多。
从空间戒指中取出一柄法杖，递给鉴定师。
年迈的鉴定师双眼一阵发亮，抬起头看了看张允，用苍老的声音道：“年轻人很不错！”说完之后，只见鉴定师取出一瓶散逸着七彩光芒的**，均匀的抹在法杖上面，法杖顿时爆发出一阵阵的七色光茫！
看见七色光茫，四周围观的群众纷纷发出吸气声。
不知道是谁高呼了一声，“神话级！”
“是啊，这是神话级物品！”
魔武世界中的装备等级分为普通级、精良级、卓越级、史诗级、传说级、圣灵级、神话级七等。
神话级的物品，是最高级别，整个游戏目前不超过五件！
张允也是激动，但面色还是平静的接过法杖放入空间戒指中。
神话级而已，他手上那枚空间戒指也是！
无尽之空，神话级物品，拥有无穷无尽的空间！这也是他成为巅峰级强者的条件之一。
当初进入游戏时，他极度极度幸运的获得了精神力、感悟力满点的属性，因此选择了魔法师这个职业。魔法师绝对是一个高消耗职业，依靠系统赠送的空间戒指毫不客气的说，张允铁定无法成为巅峰级强者！
“请再鉴定一下这个物品！”张允不理会周围人群那贪婪的目光，又从无尽之空里取出一个如同心脏的石头。

“哗~”
老鉴定师猛然站起，将座椅推翻在地。
“这这没错！没错！真的是！真的是啊！”老鉴定师激动的接过那块酷似心脏的石头，语气激动的自言自语道。
“年轻人，你打败了神话级远古炎龙阿旺达索罗都斯？”老鉴定师肯定的看着张允。
张允点头，“嗯，今天才干掉了阿旺达索罗都斯。”
“哈哈哈哈！！！！”老鉴定师兴奋的哈哈大笑，“年轻人，给我一份他的血液，我免费帮你鉴定！”
“拿去！”张允毫不犹豫的将一份龙血递上去，神话级物品的鉴定费太过于昂贵，而且看情况那块石头似乎更牛逼！
老鉴定师收下龙血后，从鉴定柜台中拿出一个水晶槽，然后有条不紊的往水晶槽中注入各种各样的**。
最终，水晶槽中的**呈现出一种诱人的深紫色。
老鉴定师拿起酷似心脏的石头，小心翼翼的放入水晶槽中。当那石头完全淹没在深紫色**中后，深紫色**突然剧烈沸腾起来。
一阵阵强烈的紫色光芒爆射而出，将整个鉴定所印得一片深紫！
张允紧张的看着那酷似心脏的石头，原本灰白色的表面正逐渐的变成紫色，而深紫色的**正慢慢的褪色。
大约过了五分钟，水晶槽中的**变得完全清澈透明，而那类似心脏的石头仿佛真的成为了一颗紫色的心脏，正在透明**中一胀一缩缓缓跳动！
不论是张允，还是四周围观的人群，这一刻都愣住了！
老鉴定师将紫色心脏从水晶槽中捞出，递给张允道：“年轻人，恭喜你了！”
张允接过来一看，顿时欣喜若狂！
神匠之心：融合了炼金、魔药、锻造、魔纹、魔药辨别、矿物辨别、魔法材料辨别七项神匠级生活技能。使用之后，将获得七项神匠级技能！特别提示，精神力不够磅礴者，请勿使用。否则后果自负！
这颗紫色的神匠之心，既不是圣灵级，也不是神话级，没有任何等级。但是，它的作用却远远超过了神话级装备！
魔武世界中的生活职业，分成学徒级、匠人级、匠师级、大师级、宗师级、神匠级六个等级。而宗师级与神匠级之间的差距不是简简单单的一级，而是一道鸿沟！
宗师级的玩家或多或少有数百位，但是神匠级的玩家确实凤毛麟角，屈指可数！

更何况，七项神匠级技能？
那是何等的逆天！！！
张允本来只有魔药、炼金、魔纹三项生活职业，其余四样只能算略懂略懂，特别是锻造，几乎是七窍通了六窍的地步！
平复了一下激动的心情，张允收起神匠之心，不理周围围观人群，法杖一挥，一道幽黑的空间裂缝出现。
他无视那错乱空间中的时空风暴，径直踏入其中。
直到这时，周围的人群才大吼起来，“神话级强者！”
“那个家伙绝对是神话级强者！”
“他是空之魔君！他是空之魔君文森！”围观中的一人认出了张允，大吼着。
张允的游戏角色名叫文森－奥古斯丁，相当西方化的一个名字，与魔武世界十分吻合。
都瑞斯主城下属的一个新人村内，虽然已经持续运营五年时间，但是新人村内还是新人辈出，不断有人加入魔武世界中。
新人村外不远处，一道幽黑的空间裂缝凭空出现，四周的新人试练怪物土狼警惕的看着这条空间裂缝。
张允一身整洁的法袍从空间裂缝中走出，道道惊天动地的气息从他身上涌出，神话级强者威压尽显！
四周的土狼夹着尾巴匍匐在地，表达出绝对的臣服！
“呵呵！”张允见状，轻笑两声，走出空间裂缝时，收敛本身的气息稍慢，没想到这些畜生倒是聪明。
再次取出紫色的神匠之心，看着它在手心凭空悬浮，一胀一缩仿佛真正的心脏一般，妖冶！但无法掩饰它的魅力！
七项神匠级生活职业！
这样的道具，简直无可想象！
五指缓缓合拢，慢慢感受神匠之心的脉搏，“使用，神匠之心！”
“叮！请问是否使用神匠之心？请确认您有足够的精神力，否则后果自负！”系统悦耳的声音传入张允耳中。
“确认！”

“即将融合神匠之心，此过程中，您将无法下线！该过程中，请您保持意识清醒，若有刺痛感，属于正常情况，请您稍作忍耐！”
这一次的系统提示居然有些许人性化的味道，这让五年来听惯了悦耳却冰冷无情的系统提示声音的张允有些受宠若惊。
紫色的神匠之心离开张允的手心，悬浮在张允心脏正前端，然后猛地一下子钻入张允的心腔内！
“啊！”
张允痛得一声大叫，却无计可施，只得暗自忍受。
神匠之心融入体内后，天空中一道道玄奥的魔纹浮现，这些魔纹首尾相接，一环连一环，将张允包裹起来。
身处魔纹圆环中心的张允，只觉得一幅幅画面、一段段文字正不断的涌入他的脑海中。这让他如同脑袋被锥子钻一般生痛！
“啊~！啊~！啊~！啊~！啊~！啊~！”
剧烈的疼痛让张允大吼大叫，可是他却咬牙忍受着！
刚才人性化的系统提示让他警觉，细细一想便发现了一些不妥之处。比如，传承神匠级技能期间保持意识清醒，比如系统主动提示有痛觉等，这让他推测，神匠之心的确能让人获得神匠级生活技能。
但前提是，能够扛得过剧烈的痛苦！
否则，神匠之心能够提升多少生活技能，那真是未知之数！
时间匆匆而过，张允痛得浑身冷汗淋漓，脸色苍白且五官扭曲，眼中透露出一股疯狂的执着。
围绕在他四周的魔纹圆环开始分解，然后投射入张允的头部。
不知道过了多久，至少张允觉得是一个世纪那般漫长，张允听见了他觉得有史以来最悦耳的系统提示。
“叮！恭喜你，完美的传承了神匠之心！”
“叮！恭喜你，你的炼金、魔药、锻造、魔纹、魔药辨别、矿物辨别、魔法材料辨别七项生活技能，提升至神匠级！”
“叮！系统通告！有玩家超过五项生活技能达到神匠级，系统即将升级，请所有玩家十分钟内下线，防止数据损失！”
“叮！系统通告！有玩家超过五项生活技能达到神匠级，系统即将升级，请所有玩家十分钟内下线，防止数据损失！”
…………

系统通告连续通告了十几遍，张允心满意足的打算下线，却发现他竟然无法下线！
“我草，怎么回事？？？”张允焦虑的大吼道。
“叮！系统异常！由于未知原因，请尽快下线！”
张允再次尝试下线，依旧是发现无法下线！
即使是选择了强制下线，也无法离开游戏！
“叮！系统错误！系统错误！……”
“嗡嗡嗡~~”
原本悦耳的系统提示，竟然变成了嗡嗡嗡的闷响，张允意识到不妙，可就是无法下线！
忽然，一阵眩晕感涌上心头，原本绝世强者的空之魔君，径直倒在地上。
更让人无法置信的是，他倒下的位置，一个极其繁复的六芒星魔法阵浮现，他正好躺在六芒星的正中心！
content_en:
FS001 Magical World
The world of magic and martial arts is the highest crystallization of contemporary technology. The second world of mankind developed by integrating virtual reality technology and online game technology!
Zhang Yun is an ordinary person, but in the world of magic and martial arts, he is a peak level powerhouse.
In the world of magic and martial arts, a mythical ancient flame dragon extinguished the eternal flame and fell in front of Zhang Yun. Zhang Yun skillfully peeled off the cramps and drained the blood, and then put away the items exploded by Yanlong.
Dragons are greedy by nature. In the cave of the mythical ancient flame dragon, there are piles of various magic metals and magic gems! As the winner, Zhang Yun took away all the raw materials without ceremony.
In the appraisal center in the main city of Duris, Zhang Yun walked up to the appraiser with excitement and said politely: "I want the equipment to be appraised!"
The people around him were already watching with curiosity as they watched him walk up to the highest-level appraiser.
Although Zhang Yun is a top player in the game, he has always kept a low profile, so not many people know him.
He took out a staff from the space ring and handed it to the appraiser.
The old appraiser's eyes shone brightly, he raised his head and looked at Zhang Yun, and said in an old voice: "Young man is very good!" After saying that, the appraiser took out a bottle of ** that emitted colorful light, and evenly applied it on the staff, and the staff suddenly erupted into bursts of seven-colored light!
Seeing the seven-colored light, the onlookers all around gasped.
I don’t know who shouted, “Mythical level!”
"Yes, this is a mythical item!"
The equipment levels in the world of magic and martial arts are divided into seven levels: ordinary level, sophisticated level, excellent level, epic level, legendary level, holy level, and mythical level.
Mythical items are the highest level, and there are currently no more than five items in the entire game!
Zhang Yun was also excited, but with a calm expression, he took the staff and put it into the space ring.
It’s just mythical, and so is the space ring on his hand!
Endless Sky, a mythical item with endless space! This is also one of the conditions for him to become a peak level powerhouse.
When he first entered the game, he was extremely lucky to have full mental power and perception attributes, so he chose the profession of magician. Magician is definitely a high-consuming profession. It is unceremonious to say that Zhang Yun will definitely not be able to become a peak powerhouse by relying on the space ring given by the system!
"Please appraise this item again!" Zhang Yun ignored the greedy eyes of the people around him and took out a heart-like stone from the endless sky.
"Wow~"
The old appraiser suddenly stood up and overturned his chair to the ground.
"That's right! That's right! It's really true! It's really true!" The old appraiser excitedly took the stone that looked like a heart and said to himself excitedly.
"Young man, have you defeated the mythical ancient flame dragon Avanda Thorodus?" The old appraiser looked at Zhang Yun with certainty.
Zhang Yun nodded, "Well, I just killed Awanda Thorodus today."
"Hahahaha!!!" the old appraiser laughed excitedly, "Young man, give me a copy of his blood, and I will help you appraise it for free!"
"Take it!" Zhang Yun handed over a piece of dragon's blood without hesitation. The appraisal fee for mythical items is too expensive, and judging from the situation, that stone seems to be even more awesome!
After receiving the dragon's blood, the old appraiser took out a crystal tank from the appraisal counter, and then poured various kinds of drugs into the crystal tank in an orderly manner.
Finally, the liquid in the crystal tank takes on an alluring deep purple color.
The old appraiser picked up the stone that looked like a heart and carefully put it into the crystal tank. When the stone was completely submerged in the deep purple liquid, the deep purple liquid suddenly boiled violently.
Waves of intense purple light burst out, printing the entire laboratory a deep purple!
Zhang Yun looked nervously at the stone that resembled a heart, his originally gray-white expressionThe face is gradually turning purple, and the dark purple breasts are slowly fading.
After about five minutes, the body in the crystal tank became completely clear and transparent, and the heart-like stone seemed to have really become a purple heart, which was slowly beating in the transparent body as it expanded and contracted!
Both Zhang Yun and the surrounding crowd were stunned at this moment!
The old appraiser took the purple heart out of the crystal tank and handed it to Zhang Yun: "Young man, congratulations!"
Zhang Yun took it over and took a look, and was immediately ecstatic!
The Heart of the Divine Craftsman: It combines the seven master-level life skills of alchemy, magic potions, forging, magic patterns, magic potion identification, mineral identification, and magic material identification. After using it, you will gain seven master-level skills! Special reminder, please do not use it if your mental strength is not strong enough. Otherwise, there will be consequences at your own risk!
This purple heart of a divine craftsman is neither a holy spirit level nor a mythical level, nor does it have any level. However, its function far exceeds that of mythical equipment!
Life occupations in the world of magic and martial arts are divided into six levels: apprentice level, craftsman level, craftsman level, master level, grandmaster level, and divine craftsman level. The gap between the Grandmaster level and the Divine Craftsman level is not simply one level, but a chasm!
There are more or less hundreds of grandmaster-level players, but craftsman-level players are indeed rare and can only be counted on one finger!
What's more, seven master-level skills?
How outrageous that is! ! !
Zhang Yun originally only had three professions in life: potion, alchemy, and magic patterns. He could only have a vague understanding of the other four, especially blacksmithing, to the point where he could almost understand six of the seven orifices!
After calming down his excitement, Zhang Yun put away his craftsmanship and ignored the crowd around him. With a wave of his staff, a dark space crack appeared.
He ignored the time and space storm in the chaotic space and stepped straight into it.
Only then did the surrounding crowd roar, "Mythical powerhouse!"
"That guy is definitely a mythical powerhouse!"
"He is the Demon Lord of the Sky! He is the Demon Lord of the Sky Vincent!" One of the onlookers recognized Zhang Yun and shouted.
Zhang Yun's game character is named Vincent-Augustin, which is quite a Western name and is very consistent with the world of magic and martial arts.
In a newbie village under the main city of Duris, although it has been in operation for five years, there are still new people emerging in the newbie village, and people are constantly joining the world of magic and martial arts.
Not far outside the Newcomer Village, a dark space crack appeared out of thin air. The newcomer trial monster Coyote around them looked at this space crack with vigilance.
Zhang Yun walked out of the space crack in a neat robe, and earth-shattering auras poured out of him, showing the power of a mythical powerhouse!
The coyotes around him crawled on the ground with their tails between their legs, expressing their absolute surrender!
"Haha!" Upon seeing this, Zhang Yun chuckled twice. When he walked out of the space crack, he restrained his breath a little slowly. Unexpectedly, these beasts were smart.
He took out the purple Heart of the Divine Craftsman again and watched it float out of thin air in the palm of his hand, expanding and contracting like a real heart, Yaoye! But you can’t hide its charm!
Seven craftsman-level life occupations!
Such props are simply unimaginable!
The five fingers slowly closed together, slowly feeling the pulse of the Divine Craftsman's Heart, "Use, the Divine Craftsman's Heart!"
"Ding! Do you want to use the Heart of the Divine Craftsman? Please make sure you have enough mental power, otherwise you will be responsible for the consequences!" The sweet voice of the system came into Zhang Yun's ears.
"Confirm!"
"The Heart of the Divine Craftsman is about to be fused. During this process, you will not be able to go offline! During this process, please keep your consciousness clear. If you feel a tingling sensation, it is normal. Please be patient!"
This time, the system prompts actually had a slightly human touch, which flattered Zhang Yun, who had been used to listening to pleasant but cold and ruthless system prompt sounds for five years.
The purple divine craftsman's heart left Zhang Yun's palm, suspended in front of Zhang Yun's heart, and then suddenly penetrated into Zhang Yun's heart.In the heart cavity!
"Ah!"
Zhang Yun screamed in pain, but had no choice but to endure it secretly.
After the Divine Craftsman's Heart was integrated into his body, mysterious magic patterns appeared in the sky. These magic patterns were connected end to end, link by link, wrapping Zhang Yun.
Zhang Yun, who was in the center of the magic circle, felt that pictures and paragraphs of text were pouring into his mind. This made him feel as painful as having his head drilled with an awl!
"Ah~! Ah~! Ah~! Ah~! Ah~! Ah~!"
The severe pain made Zhang Yun yell, but he gritted his teeth and endured it!
The user-friendly system prompt just now made him alert, and after thinking about it carefully, he discovered something wrong. For example, staying conscious while inheriting the master craftsman-level skills, such as the system actively prompting for pain, etc., led him to speculate that the master craftsman's heart can indeed allow people to obtain the master craftsman-level life skills.
But the premise is that you can withstand the severe pain!
Otherwise, it is really unknown how many life skills the craftsman’s heart can improve!
Time flew by, and Zhang Yun was so painful that he was dripping with cold sweat. His face was pale and his facial features were distorted. There was a crazy persistence in his eyes.
The magic ring surrounding him began to decompose, and then projected into Zhang Yun's head.
I don’t know how long it took, at least it seemed to Zhang Yun that it was as long as a century. Zhang Yun heard what he thought was the most pleasant system prompt in history.
"Ding! Congratulations, you have perfectly inherited the craftsman's heart!"
"Ding! Congratulations, your seven life skills of alchemy, magic medicine, blacksmithing, magic pattern, magic medicine identification, mineral identification, and magic material identification have been upgraded to the master level!"
"Ding! System notification! There are players with more than five life skills reaching the level of Master Craftsman. The system is about to be upgraded. All players are requested to log off within ten minutes to prevent data loss!"
"Ding! System notification! There are players with more than five life skills reaching the level of Master Craftsman. The system is about to be upgraded. All players are requested to log off within ten minutes to prevent data loss!"
…………
The system notifications were announced more than ten times in a row. Zhang Yun was satisfied and planned to log off, but found that he could not log off!
"Holy crap, what's going on???" Zhang Yun yelled anxiously.
"Ding! System abnormality! Please log off as soon as possible due to unknown reasons!"
Zhang Yun tried to log off again, but still found that he could not log off!
Even if you choose to force offline, you cannot leave the game!
"Ding! System error! System error!..."
"Buzz buzz~~"
The originally pleasant system prompt turned into a dull buzzing sound. Zhang Yun realized that something was wrong, but he just couldn't log out!
Suddenly, a feeling of dizziness came over him, and the Demon Lord of the Sky, who was originally a powerful man, fell straight to the ground.
What's even more unbelievable is that where he fell, an extremely complicated magic circle of six-pointed stars appeared, and he was lying right in the center of the six-pointed star!
